changelog:
- Initial release of the pm-review skill for structured PRD review workflow.
- Guides PMs through PRD review with three-phase, five-round gate-based process, ensuring full convergence to a coding-ready v3.x final draft.
- Enforces parallel review by backend, frontend, QA, and design to eliminate common pitfalls (e.g., avoiding single-end or serial reviews).
- Integrates clear feedback classification (blocking, risk, optimize) and mandates business-owner decisions on must-clarify items.
- Deeply leverages existing PM process templates, lesson libraries, and specialized review agents for professional standards.
- Provides ready-to-use checklists, templates, and review communication formats to streamline execution.
summary: PM PRD 评审 skill。PRD v1.0 产出后,引导 PM 组织三端(服务端/客户端/测试)+ 设计 review 并行,通过 5 轮迭代拿到可 coding 的 v3.x 终稿。触发场景:用户说"组织 review"、"PRD 评审"、"三端对齐"、或 workflow-start 路由到此 skill。
